description: Thermodynamic mass-action analysis of the Blastocystis SCS reaction: which metabolite concentrations permit net ATP formation
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, math, os, json

R=8.314462618e-3   # kJ/mol/K
T=310.15           # 37 C (gut)
RT=R*T
print("RT at 37 C = %.3f kJ/mol ; RT*ln10 = %.3f kJ/mol"%(RT,RT*math.log(10)))

# --- Standard free energy, ATP-forming direction:
# succinyl-CoA + ADP + Pi  ->  succinate + CoA + ATP
# Measured apparent equilibrium constants (dimensionless, 3 substrates / 3 products):
cases = {
 "Cha & Parks 1964 pig-heart SCS, pH 7.4, 25 C (K'=3.7)": 3.7,
 "thioester/ATP group-transfer bookkeeping (dGo' = -32.6 + 30.5 kJ/mol)": math.exp(2.1/ (R*298.15)),
 "conservative low end (K'=2)": 2.0,
 "conservative high end (K'=6)": 6.0,
}
rows=[]
for k,K in cases.items():
    rows.append(dict(source=k, Keq_ATPforming=round(K,2), dG0_prime_kJmol=round(-RT*math.log(K),2)))
dg=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(dg.to_string(index=False))
K_use=3.7
dG0=-RT*math.log(K_use)
print("\nUsing K'=%.1f  ->  dG'o(ATP-forming) = %.2f kJ/mol ; dG'o(succinyl-CoA-forming) = +%.2f kJ/mol"%(K_use,dG0,-dG0))

# --- Mass-action analysis -------------------------------------------------
# Q = ([succinate][CoA][ATP]) / ([succinyl-CoA][ADP][Pi])
def dG(succ, coa_over_sucCoA, atp_over_adp, Pi):
    Q = succ * coa_over_sucCoA * atp_over_adp / Pi
    return dG0 + RT*np.log(Q)

# Reference physiological set
Pi   = 10e-3        # 10 mM
AdR  = 5.0          # ATP/ADP = 5
print("\nThreshold condition for net ATP formation (dG' < 0):")
print("  [succinate] * ([CoA]/[succinyl-CoA]) < K' * [Pi] / (ATP/ADP)")
for AdR_ in [1,3,5,10,30]:
    thr = K_use*Pi/AdR_      # = succ * (CoA/sucCoA), in M
    print(f"   ATP/ADP={AdR_:>4}: [succinate]*(CoA/succinyl-CoA) must stay below {thr*1e3:7.3f} mM")
    for s in [0.5e-3, 2e-3, 5e-3, 10e-3]:
        print(f"        at [succinate]={s*1e3:5.1f} mM -> need succinyl-CoA/CoA > {s/thr:7.2f}")

# --- grids for the figure
succ_mM = np.logspace(np.log10(0.1), np.log10(30), 200)      # 0.1 - 30 mM
ratio   = np.logspace(np.log10(0.01), np.log10(100), 200)    # succinyl-CoA / CoA
S,Rr = np.meshgrid(succ_mM*1e-3, ratio)
G = dG(S, 1.0/Rr, AdR, Pi)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2))
ax=axes[0]
lev=np.arange(-12,12.1,1.5)
cf=ax.contourf(succ_mM, ratio, G, levels=lev, cmap="RdBu_r", extend="both")
ax.contour(succ_mM, ratio, G, levels=[0], colors="k", linewidths=2.5)
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_xlabel("organellar succinate (mM)")
ax.set_ylabel("succinyl-CoA / CoA ratio")
ax.set_title("Driving force of the ATP-forming direction\n(ATP/ADP = 5, Pi = 10 mM, 37 C, K' = 3.7)")
cb=fig.colorbar(cf,ax=ax); cb.set_label("$\\Delta_r G'$ (kJ/mol), ATP-forming direction")
ax.axvline(6.9, color="k", ls=":", lw=1.4)
ax.text(7.3,0.02,"Km(succinate) of\nLeishmania ASCT = 6.9 mM", fontsize=8, rotation=0, va="bottom")
ax.text(0.15,30,"net ATP formation", fontsize=10)
ax.text(8,0.02,"", fontsize=9)
ax.text(0.9,0.013,"net succinyl-CoA formation", fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
for AdR_,c in zip([1,3,5,10,30],plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0,0.85,5))):
    thr=K_use*Pi/AdR_
    need = (succ_mM*1e-3)/thr          # required succinyl-CoA/CoA
    ax.plot(succ_mM, need, color=c, lw=2, label=f"ATP/ADP = {AdR_}")
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.axhline(1.0,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("organellar succinate (mM)")
ax.set_ylabel("minimum succinyl-CoA / CoA for net ATP synthesis")
ax.set_title("Succinyl-CoA load the organelle must hold\n(Pi = 10 mM, 37 C)")
ax.legend(fontsize=9, frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

out=pd.DataFrame({"succinate_mM":succ_mM})
for AdR_ in [1,3,5,10,30]:
    out[f"min_sucCoA_over_CoA_ATPADP{AdR_}"]=(succ_mM*1e-3)/(K_use*Pi/AdR_)
print("\nwrote table rows:",len(out))
out.to_csv("scs_direction_thermodynamics.csv",index=False)
dg.to_csv("scs_standard_free_energy_sources.csv",index=False)
print(os.listdir("."))
